name: Funnel traversal — preflight only, Jetson disconnected

changes.after: OpenCV hover alignment then hold yaw; continuously update metric midpoint during approach

changes.before: stationary yaw alignment followed by landing at launch
changes.after: metric midpoint estimation, continuous approach corrections, SLAM-guided crossing and a far-side landing target

notes: Preflight only. After team approval the Jetson was unreachable over mDNS, wired 10.55.0.2 and the documented wireless address. Independent recorders had timed out on the Mac. No arm request or trajectory was issued. See flight/before-approval-launch.log and flight/final-status.log for native PX4 telemetry, and flight/preflight-only.log for the earlier ready observation. The Mac simulation was then stopped.
confounds: This is one split-platform SITL setup. Floor appearance and commanded motion changed together. Stereo tracking, timing and contact behavior are simulation-specific.
